request.prompt: Image 1 is a pixel-art avatar. Image 4 shows the person behind it, holding the avatar in front of his face. Images 2-3 show what he wears now: the avatar made into a knitted head mask that covers his whole head. Create a character reference sheet of this person wearing the knitted mask. Character: an ordinary young man; orange knitted pixel-avatar mask with a grey knitted cap top and a small pom-pom, an X-shaped left eye, a square black right eye with a green pixel pupil, a pixel smile; black hoodie. The mask is loose and keeps its own rounded shape like images 2-3, not a tight balaclava: no nose or face shape shows through. The face pattern is crisp knitted pixels on the front only. Lay it out as a clean grid of equal-size panels on one plain light grey background, one view per panel, no text, no labels.
